data.cultural_impact: In the Islamic context, 'Zumurruda' carries a powerful connotation as it is linked to the idea of strength, ferocity, and determination. In Islamic folklore, there is a prophet known as Prophet Yunus or Jonah, who was swallowed by a whale and miraculously survived. The Arabic name of the whale is 'Zumurrud' or 'Dhadhbah', highlighting the immense power and strength of this sea creature. By naming a child 'Zumurruda', parents are imbuing their child with the qualities of courage, dignity, and perseverance, just like the animal from which the name is derived.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name 'Zumurruda' can serve as a powerful reminder for the child to embody the virtues of courage, strength, and resilience in all aspects of life. In the Quran, there are numerous verses that encourage believers to have faith and strength in the face of adversity. For instance, Allah says in Surah Al-Baqarah, "And be sure we shall test you with something of fear and hunger, some loss in goods, lives, and the fruits (of your labor); but give glad tidings to those who patiently persevere." (Quran 2:155). By naming their child 'Zumurruda', parents are encouraging their child to face life's challenges with grace, strength, and courage - just as the animal symbolized by the name embodies.
